citadas.fonte: Park et al. [43] (comparacao LCA de edificios modulares pre-fabricados vs betao armado)
citadas.citacao: p.3, Sec.2 (revisao de literatura): 'Park et al. [43] conducted a comparative analysis of carbon emissions from prefabricated modular and RC buildings ... Carbon emissions were analyzed based on 30 years of use to examine each building's environmental impact during its operational lifetime.'

aplicacao_citacao: pp.4-5, Sec.3.1/Tab.1: habitacao publica Cheonan Dujeong (40 fogos, B1F-6F; ala A em betao armado, alas B/C modulares); 'only the B-wing ... was selected for analysis and compared to the same residential building'.
nota: Estudo so do estadio de producao dos materiais (A1-A3), sem vida util propria. Os 30 anos sao periodo de uso adoptado por outro estudo (Park et al.) para edificio RC/modular, citado na revisao de literatura.

aplicacao_citacao: p.11 (Sec.3 Methodology): 'A set of discrete concrete floor designs were generated for eight different slab types and different column spacings, depicting the conditions of office buildings.'
nota: Confirma a nota gravada: p.12 so diz 'All the designs are assumed to have similar design life, considering similar durability aspects of concrete buildings in general', sem numero. Analise A1-A3. Nenhum valor de vida util citado de outra fonte.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo / Sec.3: metodo LCA (CLAS) para a producao de betao pronto na Coreia, fronteira 'product stage of concrete', caso de 'production of 24 MPa concrete', sem elemento/obra de destino declarado.
nota: Nenhuma mencao a vida util/durabilidade em anos no artigo.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1: 'Acidification and eutrophication were analyzed for 24 MPa concrete ... according to increase in the mixing ratios of GGBS and recycled aggregate' — estudo da producao do betao (cradle-to-gate), sem aplicacao declarada.
nota: So mencao qualitativa a durabilidade de estruturas de betao armado (p.3), sem valor em anos.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3/Tab.3 e Tab.11: ensaio laboratorial de betao 24 MPa com W-BFS/BFS (casos 1-5); so a hipotese 'If it is applied to RC structure, therefore, it is expected to shorten construction period' (p.17), sem aplicacao concreta declarada.
nota: Limitacoes (p.16-17) referem durabilidade e 'in-service lifetime' so qualitativamente; nenhum valor de vida util.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.4 (caso de estudo): 'the amount of concrete (m3) with a nominal strength of 24 MPa that was actually produced by the RMC plant in May' — optimizacao da producao numa central de betao pronto, sem obra/elemento de destino.
nota: Nenhuma mencao a vida util; 'annual' so se refere a producao/energia anual da central.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.4/Tab.4: projectos em construcao na Coreia — C-B-58 (Commercial, Busan, 58 pisos) e C-I-49 (Commercial, Incheon, 49 pisos); 'The analyzed buildings ... include three office buildings, four multipurpose buildings, and three apartment buildings'. No C-B-58 o betao 30 MPa foi usado no 'basic mat concrete' (ensoleiramento) do edificio.
nota: Cradle-to-gate; Sec.6 diz que nao considerou uso, manutencao nem demolicao. Nenhum valor de vida util.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo: 'aims to offer a solution for repurposing CDW into building materials suitable for accelerated construction and housing in developing countries and disaster-prone areas'; Sec.1: 'early strength requirements adequate for the purposes of structural elements especially for the disaster-prone areas and/or countries with fast developing construction and housing industry'.
nota: Argamassa geopolimerica ensaiada so em laboratorio (cubos); a aplicacao (habitacao/elementos estruturais) e a finalidade declarada, nao um elemento concreto — alternativa conservadora: nao_definida. Nenhuma vida util (so 'atmospheric lifetime' do ODP e GWP a 100 anos, irrelevantes). PDF de 13,5 MB lido na integra por read_file_content (texto ate as referencias).

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.5.1 (p.4): UF 1 m3 de argamassa AAM ou OPC; 'make it suitable for multiple engineering applications, such as beams, columns, bridges, houses, etc.' — aplicacoes possiveis enumeradas, nenhuma adoptada.
nota: 'Service Life' aparece so como caixa fora da fronteira na Fig.1; conclusao menciona durabilidade 'during service life' sem valor. Nenhum valor de vida util.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.1: 'The study focuses on preparing 1 L of each concrete type in the laboratory: ordinary concrete with a water-binder ratio of 0.4 and MSWI ash micro-powder concrete ... 20%' — estudo de material em laboratorio.
nota: Nenhuma mencao a vida util ou durabilidade em anos.
